milestones.name: False Knight Encountered
milestones.note: Keyframes show the False Knight boss fight in progress, with large explosion/slam attacks visible in the Forgotten Crossroads area.

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark cavern aesthetic with large oval/seed-shaped stone doors, dense dark fungal/flower ground cover, dim blue-purple ambient lighting, and industrial machinery elements visible in second keyframe.
zones.note: Both keyframes are set here; first shows the pre-fight approach area, second shows the explosive combat phase of the False Knight arena.

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: One of the first major bosses in the game. Keyframe 2 shows his signature ground-slam shockwave attack producing large orange explosion bursts. His helmet/head is visible mid-combat.

objectives.name: Defeat False Knight
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate through the Forgotten Crossroads and engage the False Knight in his arena, surviving his slam and shockwave attacks.
objectives.note: Player has 281 Geo and 3 health masks visible in both keyframes, indicating early-game state.

connectors.description: The player traverses the flower/fungus-covered ground platforms of the Forgotten Crossroads, passing large oval stone door structures to reach the False Knight's arena.
